title: EmailSenderRequest
description: Request accepted by the email sender tool. Sending an email has side effects, so in Helios this tool is only invoked through the audit gate.

template_id.description: Which email template to render and send.

to.description: Email address of the recipient (the customer for invoice_delivery, reminder_pre_due, notice_overdue and negotiation_offer; the SME owner for escalate_to_owner).

variables.description: Values for the template placeholders. Must include every required variable for the chosen template_id; variables used only in conditional blocks may be omitted.

thread_id.description: Optional: existing conversation thread to attach the message to (a Message-ID).

invoice_ref.description: Invoice reference, used for idempotency and audit.

step.description: Optional: follow-up step number for this invoice. Part of the derived idempotency key when idempotency_key is omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: explicit idempotency key. If omitted, the sender derives hash(invoice_ref + template_id + step).

tenant_id.description: Which SME's mailbox and credentials to use. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores only: the id selects the per-tenant SMTP environment variables and idempotency store.
